name: Uptime Kuma
author: louislam

control._comment: Kuma has no monitor of itself to pause, so `kuma` is null. Stopping it cannot break any other service's stop: the pause step is best-effort everywhere and its failure never fails the action.

description: The status dashboard: probes every service on this box every 60 seconds and pushes to ntfy when one goes down or recovers. Monitors are seeded from services/monitoring/seed_kuma.py, so a new service gets its monitor by editing that file and re-running setup. Shares a compose file and .env with ntfy.

name: ntfy
author: binwiederhier

control.locked: stopping ntfy would remove the only way to start anything again from the phone

description: Push notifications to the phone. Kuma's alerts land on topic `alerts`, and anything on the box can post one with curl -d msg .../alerts. It also carries the `control` topic that ntfy-control listens on, which is how services get started and stopped from the phone. Open to the whole tailnet — no per-topic auth. Deployed together with Uptime Kuma from services/monitoring/.
